items.title: Bank earnings to shed the first light on how higher yields are affecting the economy
items.description: The big banks kick off earnings season on Tuesday, to provide a first read on the health of the economy in a rising-yield environment.

items.title: Fed officials want to hold off a rate hike this month. Will this week’s inflation data let them?
items.description: A troubling rise in prices might trigger an interest-rate move at the Fed’s meeting in late October.

items.title: This five-star money manager shares three stock picks, including one betting on dying American malls
items.description: One highly rated fund manager shares some top picks, including two names many U.S. investors will be unfamiliar with.

items.title: ‘The prospectus looks impressive’: My financial adviser wants me to invest $350,000 in a UAE data center. Is this risky?
items.description: “I’m in my 60s, recently retired and living my best life.”

items.title: The bond market is doing the Fed’s job, and that could be good news for stocks, says Morgan Stanley strategist
items.description: A stronger dollar, higher bond market yields and elevated gas prices are already tightening financial conditions in the U.S. to the point that Kevin Warsh may not even need to hike rates.

items.title: My sister moved in with our widowed mother, 78, and says she deserves the family home. Is she right?
items.description: “The house is worth $925,000 and mom owns it outright. She also has $480,000 in investments.”

items.title: Here’s why Goldman Sachs just flipped bullish on stocks for the rest of the year
items.description: Goldman Sachs is leaning more heavily into stocks for the remainder of the year. That’s down to earnings and a market that has overall gotten cheaper.

items.title: Legal battle continues as Dolly Parton’s estate claims nephew put up barbed wire to avoid summons
items.description: Dolly Parton’s estate has claimed that the late country music icon’s nephew, Bryan Seaver, went to extraordinary lengths to evade being served with a summons.

items.title: Dr. Phil lists his lavish Beverly Hills estate for a whopping $67.5 million
items.description: TV host Dr. Phil McGraw and his wife, Robin McGraw, are hoping to score an impressive return on their investment, asking more than double what they originally paid in 2016.

items.title: ‘I have no children’: My aunt gave me $50,000 for a down payment. Now she wants me to leave my home to her two children.
items.description: “The house cost $385,000. With my savings, her $50,000 and a small mortgage, I was able to close.”
